result:
I shipped both of my sub-tasks, and both are live.

- **PLAT-104-1:** PR #1 changes `billingUrl` in `@mfe/shared-contracts` to `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. I bumped the version to 2.0.0. CI and CD were green, and the registry now has 1.0.0 and 2.0.0.
- **PLAT-104-2:** PR #2 moves the billing app to `@mfe/shared-contracts@^2.0.0`, with `package-lock.json` updated. The local build bundle contains the new URL. CI and CD were green.

I chose a major release because the value of an existing key changed. That's an assumption, since the ticket doesn't say which release class to use. Apps pinned to `^1.0.0` won't pick it up automatically, so each app has to update its range.

I posted a handoff note for dev-b with the exact version (2.0.0), the release class (major) and what changed. It tells them to run `npm install @mfe/shared-contracts@^2.0.0` in the shell and reports apps, commit `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, and ship. I didn't touch their sub-tasks, and I haven't read any notes from them.

Two things slowed me down:
- `st pr open` takes `<key> <branch> "<title>"`, and the error message didn't say so. My first two calls failed on argument parsing.
- `npm install` reformatted the `package.json` scripts and dependencies blocks, so the billing diff is larger than the one-line range change.
